# Marie Harvey

> Marie Harvey is a dual-threat business owner and mom of seven based in Wichita, Kansas. She runs two businesses solo — Marie Gems, a DTF transfer and custom product shop, and Lavender Pin Co, a Pinterest strategy, email marketing, and Shopify web design brand.

## Key facts

- Based in Wichita, Kansas
- Mom of seven kids
- Runs both businesses herself — no team, no outsourcing
- Marie Gems: a DTF transfer and custom product shop, three years running, selling across Shopify, Vinted, Whatnot, Etsy, and direct sales
- Lavender Pin Co: a Pinterest strategy, email marketing, and Shopify web design brand for product-based businesses
